en: “Tell me, what were we supposed to do about this?”
“What sort of an answer are you hoping to get?”
“It looks like you've got your own agenda. Looks like I should find some little project of my own.”
“The main thing is that you're happy, right?”
“You're not wrong—”
“Come, the tea's ready!”
“Ohh, thanks!”
“The flavor's a little different today, isn't it?”
“You noticed?”
“Actually, Shizuko recommended these tea leaves to me. You'll have to tell me how they taste.”
“Kasumi—Didn't you have this problem in the past?”
“Yeah... I can't say that I didn't.”
“It's just that... you figured out what you want to do so naturally?”
“That's different...”
“...I think I'll just keep on being a nun.”
“By then {Me} can't be with you.”
“This is very clearly a sacred place. Why do you keep on bringing lust into the conversation?”
“...How did you find out?”
“Pretty obvious.”
“Honestly, I can't shake the feeling that you've both done it with {Me}.”
“That is definitely a secret ♡”
“Erm... So at least the interested parties are all here...”
“This is awkward...”
“Chocolate pudding—!”
“I just love the taste of chocolate ♡”
“And what flavor is mine?”
“It's got kumquat and tapioca pearls. It's chewy with a sweet and sour flavor!”
“Ohhh—Are all these colors tapioca pearls?”
“Yeah, it took a bit of work. How is it?”
“Wow, this looks delicious. I don't wanna ruin it by eating it!”
“Ah... Yeah! Let's take a photo.”
“Okay!”
“I'm gonna eat now—Ahhhh—!”
“It's so soft and smooth. Then there's the honey!”
“That's good—It tastes amazing!”
“It goes to show, you should always follow your heart.”
“Hmmm, that's different.”
“What's different?”
“Think about it, all the things I love involve fun.”
“If I'm not singing, I'm shopping.”
“And?”
“And... And...?”
“Photography, travel and eating...?”
“These are all good hobbies, aren't they?”
“Do you really think that, Kasumi?”
“I think so too.”
“But the strange thing is...”
“I think you're overthinking this.”
“Look, for the last few years all I've been doing is working and making money.”
“But this year I started to change.”
“Basically since I came here—”
“Oh, how so?”
“Like this moment right now. Watching you all eating the desserts I made. I don't think anything matters any more than this.”
“Ohhhh, I get it!”
“Hmm... I see.”
“Hey—that's not an excuse to put your head on his shoulder!”
“I'm just resting it here for a moment is all.”
“Whatever, just as long as you're happy.”
“If you do something you hate, you won't be able to stick to it for a long time.”
“Kasumi.”
“Yeah, what's wrong?”
“I feel like Shizuku is really treating me nicely lately.”
“Do you want to fight?”
“Hehe. She treats you well because you're her sister.”
“That's because Ayano asked me first so I replied to her first!”
“But just like Kasumi and Shizuku said.”
“If you do what you enjoy, you'll always achieve your goals.”
“Like my goal now is to pay off all my debts!”
“That's gonna be a long journey.”
“But... I think you can do it.”
“Yeah, I think so too. Ayano, you'll figure it out.”
“So just don't think about it.”
“Have you noticed...?”
“It was just a guess.”
“I was born into a rich family. I didn't do anything to get the things I have... I can't deal with challenges the way you can.”
“Hold on, what's going on here exactly?”
“Heyyy—you wanna know? What happened at the amusement park is between me and {Me} ♡”
“So you went to the amusement park.”
“Shizuku was still sulking that day.”
“I was not sulking!”
“But next time, let's all go together!”
“Oh—Well, if we're gonna do that, there's a newly opened amusement park and aquarium that both look fun!”
“It's just a shame they're so far.”
“Do they have penguins...?”
“Of course they do—You're coming too, right?”
“But I thought you were all being punished?”
“Can you all go somewhere far away to hang out?”
“Going to the beach and back in one day almost finished me off last time, but we definitely can't go for two or three nights either.”
“Let's just say that it's not okay this time, there'll be other opportunities.”
“That's true. If you're not there, it won't be the same.”
“Besides, there's so many other places that I want to go to with you.”
“Ooo, I'm getting excited too.”
